mc.protected.companion: This is the panel’s own companion plugin: disable it and the panel loses its link to the server, with nothing left to turn it back on. Remove it by hand over SFTP only.
mc.protected.known: {name} is one of the plugins the panel stands on. It cannot be disabled or deleted from here: remove it by hand over SFTP if it is no longer needed.
mc.err.toggleNeedsCompanion: Hot toggling needs the companion plugin on the game server. Without it a plugin can only be disabled by moving its file.
mc.err.companionSilent: The companion plugin did not answer — check that the server is running and the plugin is enabled
mc.err.companionNotConfigured: The companion plugin is not configured for this game server
mc.err.permsNeedCompanion: Working with permissions needs the companion plugin on the game server
mc.err.permsNeedLuckPerms: Working with permissions needs the LuckPerms plugin on the game server
mc.err.knownNeedsCompanion: The full player list comes from the companion plugin — without it only online players are visible
mc.err.ipsNeedCompanion: Known addresses come through the companion plugin
mc.err.invNeedCompanion: Viewing an inventory needs the companion plugin on the game server
mc.err.invEditNeedCompanion: Editing an inventory needs the companion plugin on the game server
mc.err.invOnlineOnly: {player} is offline right now — inventories are available for online players only
mc.err.invOfflineNeedsInvsee: {player} is offline. To view the inventories of offline players, install the InvSee++ plugin on the server
mc.err.invOfflineNoData: {player} is offline, and InvSee++ found no saved data for them
mc.err.editOfflineNeedsInvsee: {player} is offline. To edit the inventories of offline players, install the InvSee++ plugin on the server
mc.err.editOfflineNoData: {player} is offline, and InvSee++ found no saved data for them
mc.err.unknownItem: The game server does not know that item
mc.err.playerLeft: {player} left the server — the changes were not applied

mc.err.guildNotFound: Guild not found, or the guilds plugin is unavailable
mc.err.serverSilent: The game server did not answer

mc.err.ecoUnavailable: There is no currency on this server
mc.err.amountPositive: The amount must be greater than zero
mc.err.resetFailed: The password reset failed: check that AurumAuth is installed on the server and that this player is registered
mc.err.internalOnly: This endpoint is reachable from the internal network only

mc.err.downloadFailed: Could not download the plugin file: {error}
mc.err.dl.status: The source answered {status} — the file was not downloaded
mc.err.dl.tooBig: The file is over 150 MB — the panel does not take files that large

mc.err.hashMismatch: The downloaded file did not match the source’s checksum — the install was cancelled
mc.err.notAJar: The source returned something other than a jar — most likely a web page instead of the file. The install was cancelled.
mc.err.installedPluginRunning: The plugin was uploaded to {dir}/. The server is running right now — it will take effect after a restart.
mc.err.installedPluginStopped: The plugin was uploaded to {dir}/. It will be picked up the next time the server starts.
mc.err.installedModRunning: The mod was uploaded to {dir}/. The server is running right now — it will take effect after a restart.
mc.err.installedModStopped: The mod was uploaded to {dir}/. It will be picked up the next time the server starts.
mc.err.fileDisabled: {file} was moved to {dir}/ — after a restart the plugin will not load
mc.err.fileRestored: {file} was moved back to plugins/ — the plugin will load on the next start
mc.err.fileNotFound: {file} was found neither in plugins/ nor in {dir}/
mc.err.removed: The plugin file was deleted. The change takes effect after a restart.
mc.err.removedNoDataFolder: The plugin file was deleted (the data folder could not be found). The change takes effect after a restart.
mc.err.removedWithData: The plugin and its data folder were deleted. The change takes effect after a restart.
